# Draft:King Putt

King Putt (mascot)
King Putt is the official mascot of Golf N' Stuff, a family entertainment center chain with locations in Southern California and Arizona. He is depicted as a cartoonish medieval king wielding a scepter and dressed in regal robes, often holding a golf putter. King Putt serves as the fun-loving, royal ambassador of the parks, appearing at special events, in promotional materials, and occasionally in local advertising.
Appearance and Persona
King Putt is portrayed as a friendly, slightly bumbling royal figure with an oversized crown, bushy white beard, and a velvet robe decorated with golf-themed symbols. His putter doubles as a scepter, and he frequently uses exaggerated gestures and comical expressions. The character is designed to be endearing to children and nostalgic for adults.
History
The character of King Putt was first introduced in the early 1990s during a branding refresh for Golf N' Stuff. The name “King Putt” is a play on words referencing both the ancient Egyptian pharaoh King Tutankhamun (King Tut) and the act of putting in mini golf. Since his debut, King Putt has undergone several visual redesigns, modernizing his look for digital media while retaining his core attributes.
Role and Appearances
King Putt frequently appears in:
Promotional posters and brochures
Seasonal events, such as Halloween “Spooktacular” or holiday light festivals
Birthday parties at the parks
Parades and local community events
Merchandise, including plush dolls, t-shirts, and stickers
In some locations, employees in King Putt costumes appear for meet-and-greets or photo opportunities.
Cultural Impact
While not widely known outside of the southwestern United States, King Putt has become a regional cult favorite. Generations of families have grown up seeing the character during their visits to Golf N’ Stuff, and he holds nostalgic significance among locals. In recent years, King Putt has appeared in social media campaigns, where his persona has taken on a slightly more self-aware and humorous tone, appealing to older audiences.
Merchandise
Golf N’ Stuff offers limited King Putt merchandise at its parks, including:
T-Shirts
Collectible pins
Trivia
King Putt’s fictional kingdom is named Puttalot, referenced in several birthday party packages.
There was once a proposed animated short called King Putt and the Lost Hole, but it never entered production.
A parody Twitter account called “@RealKingPutt” gained modest traction before being shut down in 2017.
